analysis:
18 of 19 Grundy sequences are in the OEIS; the G10c hit (a shifted window of A014586) is spurious and G19 is
A099396 shifted by one index. Only G03 matches nothing, for both its Grundy and its P-position sequence.
assumptions: OEIS search API with on-disk cache
Grundy sequences queried from n = 1 (n = 0 is not a position for several games); P-position sequences from the first positive P-position

hypothesis: Classical closed forms (v2, Omega, popcount, n mod 3, Grundy's game) are catalogued; some relational games may not be.
methodology: novelty_check on the first 40 terms; the matched entries' names are recorded for manual reading (a shifted-window hit is not accepted as a match without inspection).
question: Which of the 19 Grundy sequences and P-position sets are already catalogued?
